liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Gimme Shelter** (1 review): Reviewer felt Gimme Shelter was the high point of the set personally [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **West L.A. Fadeaway**: back after 23 archived shows (612 days); rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **Hot Stuff**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Fa Fa Fa Fa Fa (Sad Song)**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Quitters Never Win**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [6]
- **Who Knows What Tomorrow Will Bring**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Sugaree**: rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **Space Captain**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Hard To Handle**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **soulive2014-11-15.akg.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 10 songs; 89 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]

## Around the show

- George Porter Jr. joined for West L.A. Fadeaway, and Ivan Neville joined him on Quitters Never Win [3]
- Oteil Burbridge guested on Who Knows What Tomorrow Will Bring; Jennifer Hartswick sat in on Space Captain [3]
- Lovelight featured George Porter Jr., Bernard Purdie and Roosevelt Collier; Pee Wee Ellis joined Porter on Sugaree [3]
- Audience reacted wildly to the song selection, with Chris Robinson singing with Soulive [4]
- Reviewer says Soulive's Friday set at the Purple Hat Stage impressed them even more and would like that recording [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2014-11-15.akg.flac16**: taped by Scott T.; transferred by Scott T.; source: AKG 483> V2> DR-07 [1]. Also: Recorded with AKG483 microphones into V2 and DR-07 at 24/48, by Scott T; Transfer through SoundForge with fades, tracking and L3 processing, r8brain downconversion to 16/44.1, then FLAC and tagging [1]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Matthew Wright: [Video | Chris Robinson Soulive Revue At Bear Creek](https://www.jambase.com/article/video-chris-robinson-soulive-revue-at-bear-creek) [7]
